### Time To Hit The Ground Running

ARDA delivers the fastest, most SEO-optimized Astro template available. Built for agencies and developers who want cutting-edge performance, comprehensive AI SEO features, and a stunning design system that works right out of the box.

We've taken the best parts of modern web development and made them work together seamlessly. No complex setup, no weird configurations - just everything you need to build amazing websites, ready to go.

Use whatever you're comfortable with. ARDA works with React, Svelte, Vue, Preact, or plain HTML + JavaScript. No need to learn something new.

Lightning fast. We render everything to static HTML with zero JavaScript by default. Your users get sub-1-second load times every time.

Absolutely. Add JavaScript components that only load when users need them. This keeps your site fast while still being interactive where it matters.

Yes. Full support for TypeScript, Tailwind, Sass, Markdown, MDX, and any npm package you need. Everything just works together seamlessly.

Guaranteed. Built-in AI SEO features, automatic sitemaps, RSS feeds, and Schema.org markup. Plus comprehensive llms.txt implementation for 2025 AI search.

ARDA is built on Astro's proven foundation with enhancements from our development team and feedback from the community. Trusted by developers worldwide.

Learn how ARDA delivers exceptional website performance that converts visitors into customers and ranks higher in search results.

Modern users expect lightning-fast websites. Sites that load in under 2 seconds have 90% better conversion rates, and search engines heavily favor fast-loading pages in their rankings. ARDA delivers sub-1-second load times out of the box.

ARDA uses Astro's innovative island architecture, pre-renders static content, optimizes images automatically, and eliminates unused JavaScript. This results in 95+ Lighthouse scores and exceptional Core Web Vitals.

Unlike traditional templates, ARDA combines cutting-edge performance optimization with comprehensive AI SEO features, 17 gorgeous color themes, and a complete design system. It's built specifically for 2025's web standards.

Discover ARDA's comprehensive AI SEO features designed for modern search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

ARDA includes complete Schema.org markup, AI-optimized meta descriptions, conversational content structure, semantic HTML, and advanced structured data for FAQ pages, articles, and business information.

ARDA is optimized for AI-powered search engines like Google's AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity. Content is structured with clear questions, answers, and context that AI systems can easily understand and reference.

Absolutely! ARDA provides flexible components for Schema markup, customizable meta templates, and modular SEO components you can mix and match based on your specific needs.

Everything you need to know about getting started with the ARDA template. Have a different question? We'd love to help.

You can have a fully functional website running in under 5 minutes. Just download the template, run 'pnpm install' and 'pnpm dev', and you're ready to customize. All the AI SEO features work out of the box.

Complete Schema.org markup, llms.txt for AI training, ai.txt for crawler management, optimized robots.txt, and structured data that works with ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. Everything needed for 2025 AI search.

Not at all. If you know HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript, you can customize ARDA. The component structure is intuitive, and our documentation walks you through everything step-by-step.

The opposite. ARDA is optimized for speed with static HTML generation, automatic image optimization, and zero JavaScript by default. Most sites load in under 1 second with perfect Lighthouse scores.

Absolutely. ARDA includes 17 unique color themes with a dynamic theme switcher, plus a comprehensive design system. Change colors, fonts, layouts - everything is customizable while maintaining consistency.

Complete documentation, implementation guides, and ongoing updates. Plus access to our community of developers using ARDA for their projects. We're committed to keeping this template current with the latest web standards.

### Accessibility

### Accessibility is not optional—it's essential.

**Visual Accessibility**

**Keyboard Navigation**

**Screen Reader Support**

**Motor Accessibility**

**WCAG Compliance**

**Legal Compliance**

**Testing & Validation**

**Accessibility Tools**

**Color Palette Selector**

**Text Scaling**

**Reduced Motion**

Building inclusive experiences for everyone.

We're committed to creating digital experiences that are usable by everyone, regardless of their abilities. Our accessibility-first approach ensures compliance with WCAG guidelines and creates better experiences for all users.

Our websites meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA standards, ensuring compliance with accessibility regulations including:

Choose from high-contrast color schemes

Adjust font sizes up to 200% zoom

Respect user motion preferences

- High contrast color schemes
- Scalable fonts and UI elements
- Alternative text for images
- Color-blind friendly design

- Full keyboard accessibility
- Logical tab order
- Visible focus indicators
- Skip navigation links

- Semantic HTML structure
- ARIA labels and descriptions
- Proper heading hierarchy
- Descriptive link text

- Large touch targets (44px minimum)
- Adequate spacing between elements
- No time-sensitive interactions
- Alternative input methods

- • Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- • Section 508 (US Federal)
- • EN 301 549 (European)

- • Automated accessibility testing
- • Manual testing with assistive technologies
- • User testing with disabled users

### Additional Resources

A comprehensive overview of our design system including color palettes, typography, components, and interactive elements. Explore each section in detail.
